data.one_liner: Save image or video files to the device gallery on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple API to write image bytes or file paths directly into the native photo library. Uses platform channels to invoke native code for both Android and iOS.
use_when: You need to store captured or generated media in the user's gallery
You want a lightweight plugin without extra UI components
avoid_when: You require advanced media management like albums or metadata
strengths: Handles required permissions on Android and iOS
weaknesses: Only supports Android and iOS, no web/desktop
Limited to saving, no retrieval or browsing of gallery
data.setup_notes: Add NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription to iOS Info.plist; ensure Android write permissions are granted (handled by plugin).

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you also need to pick images from the gallery, not just save them
